audit.whatIsWrong: Sides gave Volibear five rows plus two Skill rows, with no stage anywhere conceded to Dr. Mundo despite a 48.2% win rate over 973 games.
audit.why: The audited drmundo__volibear mirror sets the chart to L1 Volibear, L2 Volibear, L3 Volibear, L4-5 Dr. Mundo, L6 Volibear, First item Dr. Mundo, 2+ items Dr. Mundo, and fixes carryRating at 6/10.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Volibear, rows 3, 5 and 6 to Dr. Mundo, as matched full/content pairs; ratings 6,6,7,4,7,4,3; carryRating 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The lane text used two retired ability names — 'Sadism' for his R and 'Burning Agony' for his E — and carried no cooldowns.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: R is Maximum Dosage (120s), E is Blunt Force Trauma (9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s), W is Heart Zapper (17/16.5/16/15.5/15s), Q is Infected Bonesaw (4s, 975 range).
audit.corrected: All four renamed with their cooldowns written into early, mid, late, all four spikes, whys[4], whys[5] and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him.
audit.why: That means Thundering Smash's stun does NOT land the first time — he takes health damage instead and drops a chemical cannister he can walk over to heal and cut the passive's cooldown. Every 'Q-stun all-in' line on this page assumed a stun that does not happen. Heart Zapper also STORES a portion of the damage he takes and heals a share of it on the burst, which is why a long grind loses even when your damage is higher.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[0], spikes[2], mid, phases[3].why and phases[5].why, with the fix: bait the passive with Sky Splitter before you commit Thundering Smash, and bring Grievous Wounds.

audit.why: The passive is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: That sentence was replaced wholesale in the spikes[0] rewrite.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Dr. Mundo down every time Heart Zapper is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: His passive resists your first immobilizing effect — Thundering Smash's stun is eaten and he drops a cannister that heals him back.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Dr. Mundo to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: First item is his: Heart Zapper (17s) stores the damage you deal and heals a share of it back when the burst lands.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Dr. Mundo can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: Two items in, Maximum Dosage (120s) heals a percentage of his missing health and his regen outlasts you. Anti-heal is not optional here.

edits.before: Level 1 is an even skill check on dodging Bonesaw.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — dodge Bonesaw and he has nothing.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your DPS and stun keep denying his HP snowball.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 go to him — his regen simply outlasts you.

edits.before: At 6 your Stormbringer all-in with E-slow beats his Sadism heal.
edits.after: At 6 Stormbringer's dive beats Maximum Dosage's heal if you burst.

edits.before: By first item your Sheen spike out-DPS his Burning Agony sustain.
edits.after: By first item Heart Zapper (17s) heals back what you traded.

edits.before: With 2+ items your dive and repeatable R out-pace his regen.
edits.after: With 2+ items his raw health and regen outlast your dive.

edits.before: Dodge Mundo's Infected Bonesaw (Q) — it's his only reliable poke and slow, and if it whiffs he can't kite your Q-stun; W-maul him while his Q is on cooldown and your Relentless Storm out-sustains his passive regen early.
edits.after: Infected Bonesaw is up every 4s at 975 range and hits for current health — dodge it and he cannot kite you. But Goes Where He Pleases resists your first immobilizing effect, so the Thundering Smash stun is eaten.

edits.before: Stormbringer beats his Sadism (R): leap in and E-slow so he can't walk out of your DPS, and your burst plus passive shred can drop him before his R heal fully turns the fight if you commit hard.
edits.after: Stormbringer (160s) can beat Maximum Dosage (120s): leap in, Sky Splitter to slow so he cannot walk away, and burst him down before the missing-health heal has time to turn the fight.

edits.before: Keep the pressure — your Sheen spike and passive still out-DPS his Burning Agony (E) sustain, and denying him CS with Q-stun poke stops his HP-scaling snowball before it starts.
edits.after: First item swings to him: Heart Zapper (17s) stores the damage you deal and heals a share of it back, so bring Grievous Wounds before you commit to a long trade.

edits.before: Late is still yours if you built into him: your tankiness and repeatable R let you dive and burst him faster than Sadism can heal, but avoid letting him free-farm into raw HP or he becomes a slow-you-forever brick.
edits.after: Late is his if he free-farms: Blunt Force Trauma scales its damage off max and missing health, and Maximum Dosage heals a percentage of what is missing. Anti-heal and end it before he stacks health.

edits.before: Level 1-2 hinges on whether he lands Bonesaw (Q) — dodge it and you win the exchange, eat it and he kites you, so it's an even skill check.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 hinge on Infected Bonesaw (4s, 975 range) — dodge it and you win the exchange, eat it and he kites you off the wave entirely.

edits.before: From level 3 on you're ahead: your Q-stun, W-maul and passive DPS out-trade his single-target poke, and your level-6 Stormbringer all-in can beat his Sadism heal if you slow-lock him with E.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are yours, but from 4 on his regen takes over. His passive eats your first stun and drops a cannister he heals from, so bait it with Sky Splitter before you commit Thundering Smash.

edits.before: Even with 2+ items you stay favoured — your dive threat and passive shred out-pace his regen — provided you don't let him free-farm into unkillable HP.
edits.after: With two items he outlasts you — Maximum Dosage plus his passive regen beat raw damage, so bring Grievous Wounds and never grind a long fight.

edits.before: E-slow so he can't kite with Q during your DPS
edits.after: Sky Splitter's slow so he cannot kite with Q

edits.before: Ult (Sadism) mid-trade to out-heal your burst
edits.after: Maximum Dosage mid-trade to out-heal you

notes: The passive interaction is the headline correction here and it changes the matchup's whole plan: Goes Where He Pleases resists the FIRST immobilizing effect, so the page's repeated 'Q-stun all-in' advice was built on a stun that does not land. Riot's text does not say whether the resist consumes on any immobilize or only on hard CC of a certain class, so I described it exactly as Riot does and told the reader to bait it. The side token for the enemy rows is written 'Dr. Mundo' to match the mirror and the packet's enemyDisplay.
